verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai (HTTP 200). The Computer documentation is published as raw Markdown pages (the .md URLs on the MCP server and analytics docs), and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. The 404 probe was only a doubled '.md.md' path and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: confirmation that the llms.txt indexes the Computer pages specifically (its excerpt describes the general Perplexity API/Agent API docs), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
